q1.explanationZh: 第二段列出她用空气炸锅做过的很多东西：牛里脊、蟹腿、龙虾尾、南瓜派，所以它能做各种各样的菜。

evidence.quote: Beef tenderloin, crab legs, lobster tails, and pumpkin pie—she has made them all in the appliance.

q2.explanationZh: Fred 说以前在家做薯条太花时间，而且效果常常让人失望，也就是又慢又不满意。

evidence.quote: making French fries at home took too long and usually produced disappointing results.

q3.explanationZh: Fred 说他没想到自己的炸锅会像现在这么火，可见他对它的巨大成功感到意外。

evidence.quote: But I didn’t expect my fryer to be as big as it is now.

q4.explanationZh: Megha 说买空气炸锅不只是为了做薯条，而是想把昨天做的剩菜变得更好吃，也就是用新办法做旧菜。

evidence.quote: it’s about how to get the best out of the food we made yesterday.

q5.explanationZh: 空气炸锅天天用，微波炉和烤箱却在“休息”，所以 have had one’s day 的意思是不再受欢迎了。

evidence.quote: as in most homes, they are now taking a break
